Why it’s harder for PhD holders in companies
The problem is not only money.
Private-sector R&D jobs are still limited in Morocco.
Many companies don’t have research departments.
So where do PhD holders go?
But wait…
A PhD is not only for becoming a professor.

Where a PhD can take you
Universities and labs
The classic path: teaching and research.
Company R&D
Companies hire PhDs to build new products and solve hard problems.
Example: OCP
From our debate: OCP invests up to 5 billion MAD per year in research.
Research needs people like us
Research isn’t only chemistry and labs.
AI
Data
Information systems
Cybersecurity
Decision support
Data and AI profiles are in high demand in Morocco.
So MGSI profiles fit in research too.
The third path
BOTH
You don’t have to choose.
Industrial PhD: a company hires you and pays you while you do your thesis.
~25,000 €
per year minimum (CIFRE, France)
96%
of CIFRE PhDs find a job quickly
Or do it while working, like 40–50% of PhD students in Morocco.
Or: work first, do a PhD later.
It’s not “PhD or job.”
The real question:
What kind of problems do you want to solve?
